name: Parshoone
description: Parshoone was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, controlled by the Imperial Remnant. It was an Ubiqtorate contact station.
lead_paragraphs: Parshoone was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, controlled by the Imperial Remnant. It was an Ubiqtorate contact station.
Parshoone was the homeworld of Isila Drutch.
